question: How is the sixteen-world group of the beyond-peace level defined?
premises: The central-channel domain, the cavity of Brahman, Kuṇḍalinī, the five Vyāpins, and Samanā are listed.
Together these form a sixteen-world group.
This group is identified with the pair of tattvas of the beyond-peace level.
inference: The śāntyatītā level consists of sixteen worlds corresponding to a pair of tattvas and culminating in Samanā.
uncertainties: The exact internal count that yields sixteen from the listed items is not itemized in the verse.
plain_english: The central-channel domain, the cavity of Brahman, Kuṇḍalinī, the five Vyāpins, and Samanā together make up this sixteen-world group. This is the pair of tattvas belonging to the level beyond peace.
